reviews.text: My Kyra has grown up and still goes there. Thanks to them she has become special and unique.

We received a truly excellent welcome...plenty of space for our furry friends🐶...
We started our first puppy program and were very satisfied.
A special thank you to Elena...the passion, love, and dedication she conveys are indescribable...in addition, of course, to her impeccable expertise.
Beautiful experience... beautiful park. My little girl had so much fun.

Wonderful spaces for dogs.
Dr. Pierantonio is a leading expert in the well-being of the family's four-legged friends.

1 star because it can't be any less!
They call it a sensory forest (there's nothing sensory about it) for our four-legged friends, but in reality, it's a path, poorly maintained, full of brambles and undergrowth, unmaintained, dangerous for the dog, whom I couldn't leave off the leash. It was an interminable 45 minutes because, once the narrow, walkable path was over, I didn't know what else to do. The dog wanted to run alone, but I couldn't leave him! €20 without a receipt, thrown to the wind.

Heaven on earth for us and our four-legged friends. Very competent, friendly, empathetic, and kind staff.
Attentive to the needs of our four-legged friends, always present. THANK YOU.

The trainers are very knowledgeable and willing to help in any way they can.
I also went to the sensory forest with my dog, and it was very helpful.

I was there for the first time with my big dog (a 45kg mixed breed) and his friend (a pit bull)...
The Sensory Forest is a wonderful experience for dogs, where they can express themselves freely, sniff things they can't easily find in the city, get lost in the woodland crevices and then find their way back to their owners...
In short, I'm sure I'll be back again and again!

Just today I called to ask for advice about a problem with my dog. The doctor wasn't available, but Elena, a dog trainer who works at this school, helped me. She's knowledgeable, kind, and helpful. She reassured me and patiently explained …
Very nice and well-kept place. Very kind and helpful staff.
What a show, our dog was cuddled, understood and learned agility together with his mommy.
